title: Tiny, cute rocket ship
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='bodyGrad' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ff9ecb'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#e8508f'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='noseGrad' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffe08a'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#ffb630'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='flameGrad' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#fff59e'/>
      <stop offset='55%' stop-color='#ffb340'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#ff5c38'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- flames -->
  <path d='M42 78 Q50 98 58 78 Q50 86 42 78 Z' fill='url(#flameGrad)'/>
  <path d='M46 78 Q50 90 54 78 Q50 82 46 78 Z' fill='#fff6c4'/>
  <!-- fins -->
  <path d='M32 58 Q18 68 24 80 Q32 76 34 68 Z' fill='#5ad1e6'/>
  <path d='M68 58 Q82 68 76 80 Q68 76 66 68 Z' fill='#5ad1e6'/>
  <!-- rocket body -->
  <path d='M50 16 Q70 34 70 62 Q70 74 50 80 Q30 74 30 62 Q30 34 50 16 Z' fill='url(#bodyGrad)'/>
  <!-- nose cone -->
  <path d='M50 16 Q62 28 62 40 Q56 36 50 35 Q44 36 38 40 Q38 28 50 16 Z' fill='url(#noseGrad)'/>
  <!-- window -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='52' r='10' fill='#2b2f6b'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='52' r='10' fill='none' stroke='#bff3ff' stroke-width='2.5'/>
  <circle cx='46' cy='48' r='3' fill='#9fe8ff' opacity='0.9'/>
  <!-- tiny eyes on window for cuteness -->
  <circle cx='46' cy='53' r='1.8' fill='#7ff2e0'/>
  <circle cx='54' cy='53' r='1.8' fill='#7ff2e0'/>
  <path d='M47 57 Q50 59 53 57' fill='none' stroke='#7ff2e0' stroke-width='1.2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- body stripe -->
  <path d='M34 66 Q50 72 66 66' fill='none' stroke='#ffffff' stroke-width='2' opacity='0.6' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- side boosters -->
  <rect x='24' y='62' width='7' height='14' rx='3' fill='#ffd166'/>
  <rect x='69' y='62' width='7' height='14' rx='3' fill='#ffd166'/>
</svg>
